frame: library frame of the three-link arm: base yaw axis is the z axis, z up, table plane z = 0, shoulder at (0, 0, l0), at theta = 0 the arm lies along +y; tool(theta) = (-sin t0 R, cos t0 R, l0 - l1 sin t1 - l2 sin(t1 + t2)), R = l1 cos t1 + l2 cos(t1 + t2); the elbow point is the same with l2 = 0; negative t1 raises the arm
units: metres for lengths, degrees for cell corners and waypoints, radians for the inflation
links: two capsules of radius link_radius around the segments shoulder-elbow and elbow-tool; the base column below the shoulder is not modelled as a link

obstacles.name: divider
obstacles.meaning: plate in the plane x = 0 between the pick side x < 0 and the place side x > 0

obstacles.name: shelf
obstacles.meaning: place shelf on the side x > 0, top at z = 0.12

obstacles.name: rear_wall
obstacles.meaning: y <= -0.25, a wall behind the base

joint_envelope.note: every cell inflated by 1/10 rad in each joint lies in this box (6 degrees >= 1/10 rad since pi >= 3); no clearance certificate is claimed on the margin beyond the 1/20 rad inflation

certificates.note: separating plane (n, beta) with |n| <= 1: the obstacle lies in n.p <= beta, and n.p >= beta + link_radius + clearance at the shoulder, elbow and tool points for every theta of the inflated cell

cycle_note: a run starts at home, moves to lift_pick, then repeats the template for any pick slot i and place slot j; consecutive waypoints share a cell
straight_move_note: the straight joint-space move from a pick slot to a place slot passes theta0 = 0 with the tool low and penetrates the divider; no cell contains both ends
tool_lipschitz_note: |tool(theta) - tool(theta')|_2 <= L max_i |theta_i - theta'_i| for all theta, theta' (L^2 >= (l1 + 2 l2)^2 + (l1 + l2)^2)
